introduction: Inanimate Insanity: Season 1 Remastered (abbreviated as II 1R) is an expanded remake of the first season of Inanimate Insanity. While it follows the same basic storyline and short episode length, the episodes now feature a number of changes and an updated animation style reminiscent of the original version's first style. Unlike the original season, the remake's visuals are consistent and do not change over time.The remaster was teased on February 22, 2025 at the end of a compilation video of the original Season 1, displaying a date of March 1, 2025. On that day, the release dates for the first two episodes were revealed. Between "The Stacker (Remastered)" and "War De Guacamole (Remastered)", the remaster had a short hiatus due to the launch of Inanimate Insanity IV and the BFDI x II 2025 Tour
